newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's peso gains as banks cash in greenbacks.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's peso gains as banks cash in greenbacks.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 4.1 to close at 1,075 pesos against the dollar as banks moved to cash in greenbacks to make up for shortfalls in peso liquidity, interbank traders said.
Bank overnight peso lending rates stood at 27 percent at mid-morning, but had dropped to 24 percent by the close as banks shortened dollar positions.
Traders said the peso gained in the face of little industry demand for the extra dollars entering markets.
Dealers reported 336 trades worth a total $136 million. The peso opened at 1,083.7 per dollar, sank to an intraday low of 1,084.5 and hit a high of 1,074.
